title: SOCIA-$\nabla$: Textual Gradient Meets Multi-Agent Orchestration for Automated Simulator Generation
abstract:
arXiv:2505.12006v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this paper, we present SOCIA-$
abla$, a diagnosis-driven multi-agent framework for automated simulator-code construction. SOCIA-$
abla$ iteratively refines executable simulator code within a textual computation graph, where LLM-driven agents synthesize, execute, evaluate, diagnose, and repair simulators. A grounded simulator blueprint attributes behavioral residuals to candidate mechanisms and their spatial or interaction contexts, which are then converted into localized textual repair signals with history-aware memory and constraint projection. We evaluate SOCIA-$
abla$ on the real-world LLMob personal-mobility benchmark and a controlled semi-synthetic geo-social mask-adoption benchmark. Across in-distribution simulation, out-of-distribution what-if generation, and geo-social diffusion, SOCIA-$
abla$ achieves the strongest overall simulator fidelity. SOCIA-$
abla$'s code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/

translated_title: SOCIA-$\nabla$：文本梯度与多智能体编排相结合的自动化模拟器生成方法
translated_abstract:
本文提出了SOCIA-$
abla$，一个面向自动化模拟器代码构建的诊断驱动多智能体框架。SOCIA-$
abla$在文本计算图内迭代优化可执行的模拟器代码，其中由大语言模型驱动的智能体对模拟器进行合成、执行、评估、诊断和修复。基于事实依据的模拟器蓝图将行为残差归因于候选机制及其空间或交互情境，随后借助具有历史感知记忆和约束投影的机制，将其转化为局部化的文本修复信号。我们在真实世界的LLMob个人出行基准和一个受控的半合成地理社会口罩采纳基准上对SOCIA-$
abla$进行了评估。在分布内模拟、分布外“假设”情景生成以及地理社会扩散等任务中，SOCIA-$
abla$均实现了最强的整体模拟器保真度。SOCIA-$
abla$的代码和数据已在https://github.com/ 公开。
tldr: SOCIA-$\nabla$提出了一种诊断驱动的多智能体框架，通过文本计算图中的局部化文本梯度修复信号，使大语言模型智能体能够迭代地合成、执行、评估、诊断和修复模拟器代码，在多个真实与半合成基准上实现了最先进的模拟器保真度。
en_tdlr: SOCIA-$\nabla$ introduces a diagnosis-driven multi-agent framework that leverages localized textual gradient repair signals within a textual computation graph, enabling LLM agents to iteratively synthesize, execute, evaluate, diagnose, and repair simulator code, achieving state-of-the-art simulator fidelity across real-world and semi-synthetic benchmarks.
